chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, disliked six traits for me, and I disliked them for the awsiya' from my descendants and for their followers after me: frivolity in salat (prayer), indecent speech in sawm (fasting), reproach after charity, entering the mosques in a state of janabah, looking into houses, and laughing among the graves.

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charity given for the sake of Allah
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors, referring to the designated successors from his descendants
key_terms.جُنُبًا: in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah)

ai.seo_question: What six traits did Allah dislike for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and for the awsiya' from his descendants and their followers?
ai.summary: This hadith lists six disliked traits connected to worship, personal conduct, and social etiquette. It presents them as matters the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم also disliked for the awsiya' from his descendants and for their followers after him, showing a model of disciplined and reverent conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.575 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, dislikes six traits for me, and I also dislike them for the successors (Imams) from my descendants and for their followers after me: playing around during prayer, inappropriate speech during fasting, boasting after giving charity, entering mosques while in a state of major ritual impurity, peeking into people’s houses, and laughing among graves."
